steps.text: The disc image must be imported with the game's own installer. Download AnimalCrossing-Quest zip from the GitHub release, extract it, close Animal Crossing on the headset and run Install-Quest.cmd. Choose your Animal Crossing USA Rev 0 (GAFE01) .iso, .gcm or .ciso when asked. RVZ and zipped images do not work.
Do not uninstall the app or clear its data. That deletes the stored disc image and your saves.

otherWays.label: Animal Crossing VR Quest package
otherWays.help: Extract AnimalCrossing-Quest-<version>.zip and run Install-Quest.cmd on Windows. It installs the game and imports your disc image. QGPUI needs it for the disc image too.

notes: The disc image goes into app-private storage through Install-Quest.cmd or device_data.py (both in the Quest zip); the guide says not to copy it into Android/data by hand, so QGPUI cannot push it. QGPUI could later run device_data.py itself. The disc is GAFE01 revision 0.
